status: frozen before constructing cells, controls or fitting a spatial model
inference: associational case control analysis of satellite detected thermal activity in August 2026, not causal inference and not a model of ignitions or burned area
research_question: Within municipalities of Tolima, were one kilometre cells with at least one VIIRS Suomi NPP NRT thermal detection in August 2026 associated with topographic setting and membership in the UPRA agricultural frontier, compared with cells without a detection?

outcome.definition: case cell is an EPSG 3116 one kilometre cell containing at least one Tolima detection dated 1 through 31 August 2026

eligible_population.grid: one kilometre EPSG 3116 cells whose centre is within one of the 47 municipal polygons
eligible_population.control_definition: eligible cell with no August 2026 detection
exclusions: cells without a finite DEM sample
cells not assigned uniquely to one municipality

matching.stratum: one case plus three controls sampled without replacement from the same municipality
matching.selection_rule: controls are sampled uniformly from eligible non case cells within each case municipality. A control cannot be selected twice.
matching.failure_rule: if a municipality has insufficient unique controls for the frozen ratio, retain all available controls and report the reduced ratio without replacement

topography.source: Copernicus DEM GLO 90 tiles audited in data/raw/copernicus_dem_glo90_tolima_2026-09-06
features: local slope sampled at cell centroid
topography.method: slope is derived from the 90 metre DEM using local latitude adjusted metre spacing at the sampled cell centroid

territorial.feature: fraction of cell area within the UPRA frontier union
territorial.interpretation_limit: planning frontier membership is not observed land use, agriculture, human presence or an ignition mechanism

excluded_predictors.roads: INVIAS complete geometry download was blocked. No distance to roads is estimated.
excluded_predictors.pixel_land_cover: The audited MapBiomas product available locally is department annual statistics, not a Tolima raster suitable for cell attribution.
excluded_predictors.weather: A single August spatial case control analysis does not identify dynamic weather effects. Preseason weather is evaluated in the regional temporal panel.

modelling.primary: conditional logistic regression with matched case control stratum fixed effects and elevation, slope and frontier fraction
modelling.functional_form: continuous predictors are centred at the median and divided by IQR over the analytic sample. Frontier fraction enters as a continuous proportion.
modelling.nonlinearity_sensitivity: replace linear elevation with four predeclared elevation quartile indicators. Do not add splines unless diagnostics show a material failure.
modelling.spatial_sensitivity: repeat after retaining one case per five kilometre cell to reduce local clustering
prohibited: using controls as confirmed no fire
